last_assistant_message:
I haven't written the plan yet, because the inputs it has to build on are not on main.

The decision record says to plan against `test-suite-prune-core` and `test-suite-prune-rest` once both have landed on main. Neither has: prune-core is 9 commits ahead of main and prune-rest is 11 ahead. Those two branches rewrite most of the test files this plan's cards would edit. `lyx quarry` and `lyx loom validate-plan` only look at this worktree, so a plan written now could point at tests that the prunes later rename or delete.

I've sent `ly:orch` two options:
- **(a)** Wait until both prunes land and this pair is rebased onto main, then write the plan. This is my recommendation.
- **(b)** Write it now against the current code and redo the test-file targets after the prunes land.

Nothing is in `_lyx/plan` yet. I'll start once `ly:orch` replies.
